title: Odile and the Will
author: Sebastian Nakamura
blurb: Yara Vane, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
